tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Screen background (HIG grouped background). Flutter: ColorScheme.surfaceContainerLowest / scaffoldBackgroundColor.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, list rows, detail sections, app bar when scrolled. Flutter: ColorScheme.surface.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Search field fill, skeleton blocks, pressed row. Flutter: ColorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface and surface-2 (16:1). Brand names, headings, body.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg, surface and surface-2 (≥5.4:1): generic name, manufacturer, captions, section labels.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Non-text only (≥3.5:1 on surface): placeholder icon, chevrons, inactive tab icons. Never body text.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between list rows and detail sections. Decorative; not a control border.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand teal: primary buttons, links, active tab, focus ring, 'Show more'. Text on surface ≥6:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label on a primary fill (6.1:1 light, 9:1 dark).

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill: active-ingredient tags, disclaimer banner, secondary button.

tokens.name: on-primary-soft
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary-soft (≥6.8:1).

tokens.name: favorite
tokens.usage: Filled heart when a medication is saved, Favorites tab badge. Orange, told apart from teal by lightness and shape (filled vs outline).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error-state icon and title, destructive swipe 'Remove'. Text on danger-soft ≥5.7:1.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error-state icon disc, network error inline banner.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Label of the Warnings section and the rate-limit (HTTP 429) state. Text on warning-soft ≥6.4:1.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warnings section header fill, rate-limit notice.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind bottom sheets (language picker).

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: Collapsing app-bar title on top-level tabs (Medications, Favorites).

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Brand name at the top of Medication Detail. Wraps up to 3 lines.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Brand name in list rows (1 line, ellipsis); section titles in detail.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Temporarily relieves minor aches and pains.
styles.usage: Detail section body (purpose, dosage, warnings). Long label text collapses after 6 lines.

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: Generic name in list rows; search field text; state-view message.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels, tag text, tab labels (tab labels at 500).
